The binary (escalation vs. deal) means regime could flip with zero warning.

**[BLIND_SPOT — COMMODITY BULL vs. FINANCIAL ASSET ROTATION]** | Severity: 8/10

No other source corroborates the equity bullish view. The absence of a divergence flag in the raw data is itself a gap — **this is a system blind spot**. The data asymmetry note applies inversely here: sources are more bearish on financial assets than neutral data would suggest, meaning the source signal is credible and should be respected over any "neutral = fine" reading.

**[CONTRARIAN — EQUITY_VALUATION BULLISH vs. EVERYTHING ELSE]** | Severity: 6/10

**[BLIND_SPOT — EUROPEAN AUTO / CHINA_EM]** | Severity: 5/10  
Two novelty-7 claims on VW/Stellantis crisis and Chinese hybrid market share expansion have NO corresponding consensus score (CHINA_EM = NO_DATA). **F6 system should screen for unusual put volume in European auto ADRs or related ETFs (VWAGY, STLA).** This structural deterioration story is underrepresented in the consensus map.
